easy.home_subtitle: Pick what you want to do. The house button at the top always brings you back here.
easy.basic_language_note: Basic voices can only read English and Chinese. For other languages, first add your own voice in ‘My voices’.
easy.my_voice_speed_note: Speech in your own voice is made at normal speed.
easy.download_body: Press ‘Get’ below. The files are large, so Wi-Fi is best.
easy.speak_desc: Choose the model, language and voice yourself.
easy.dictate_desc: Speak and your words are typed out right away.
easy.handoff_desc: Back up your projects and move them between phone and computer.
easy.calls_desc: Make and answer calls in a JinVoice voice through your computer.
easy.help_setup_1: This app makes speech right on your phone. The first time, it downloads the files it needs (Wi-Fi is best).
easy.help_setup_2: To use JinVoice on your computer instead, connect it in Settings → Connect.
easy.help_setup_3: Basic voices read English and Chinese. For other languages, first add your own voice in ‘My voices’.
easy.help_create_4: Press ‘Save’ to keep it as a WAV file, or ‘Share’ to send it to another app.
easy.help_book_1: On the home screen, choose ‘Read long text’.
easy.help_book_2: Paste your text or open a file; it is split into chapters for you.
easy.help_book_3: Pick a voice, make it, then save or share the finished file.
easy.help_more_1: Press the gear button ‘Settings’ at the top right.
easy.help_more_2: In ‘Turn features on and off’, switch on only what you need. It then appears under ‘More features’ on the home screen.
easy.help_more_3: Turn on ‘Show all features (advanced)’ to see every original menu. ‘Easy screen’ at the top of that home screen brings you back.
